path.id: Give a concern a place, time and meaning.

Poor lighting, isolated stretches and street hazards can leave people feeling unsafe. Without a clear way to report where and when these concerns occur, they can go unrecorded and remain difficult for others to anticipate.
The concept combines a map, incident details and an emergency-help entry. Holding and dragging explores how severity and extent could be expressed.
Proposed shortcut: save a location and add details later, once safe. Hardware access and reliability still need validation.
A saved map location supports reporting later.
Holding explores severity through colour; discoverability needs testing.
Dragging expresses the affected extent, not just one point.
Hold to explore the severity interaction.
Drag to describe how far the concern extends.
Add incident details so others can interpret the marker.
Show both the intensity and extent of a concern.
Incident type, date and time make the report more specific than an undated area marker.
Getting urgent help and sharing a concern have different next steps.
